scientific_scope: Two separate joint five-task frozen-motor steering PPO learners; preserve actual steering histories for later AD/DPT

kv_all_layers.qualification: New all-layer map; old last-layer-value Stage 0 qualification does not carry over

training.episode_schedule: Balanced interleaving of all five tasks in every round; fresh native instances; preserve task and global policy-version identities
training.reward: Simulator first success, +1 in its H50 chunk; later chunks physically execute to full horizon but are excluded from PPO loss
training.native_noise: Explicit recorded native iid Gaussian, fixed law; only steering coefficients are learned. Native nuisance-noise density cancels in the PPO ratio
training.policy: Fresh zero-mean Gaussian steering actor and value MLP on the same pre-action public feature port; 2064 feature coordinates
training.stop: Fixed round count, except numerical/runtime/resource failure; development performance is monitoring, not an automatic performance stop
training.accounting: Every actual reset, failed or unresolved call is charged; 103 balanced rounds preserve reset and qualification headroom within 5M total TRAIN controls.

evaluation.baseline: Verify the previously collected 500-case common-before; reuse only compatible evidence; new canonical pairing before panels are reserved if needed
evaluation.primary: Macro-average ID first-success gain over the original zero-steering policy on paired cases; report paired uncertainty and exact tests
secondary: OOD macro-average first-success and success at end
evaluation.selection: Fixed final checkpoint for confirmatory evaluation; development results do not select a final test checkpoint

resources.admission: Actual allocated probes, storage/write/capacity, zero-output native parity, all-layer K/V influence, one counted PPO update and complete recovery qualification
resources.cap_source: Existing Stage 1 human-approved handoff; no larger GPU-hour budget is inferred from approval of 5M controls per arm.
resources.throughput_qualification: Measure one counted update and before/evaluation throughput within the existing cap; complete checkpoints and seek a concrete budget decision if the approved data target cannot fit.

retention: raw current and next decision observations
full native three-view videos and action accounting
other_work: Closed Flow and Stage 0 remain immutable; the older single-task four-learner warm-start proposal is not duplicated; no Flora, student fit or new scientific task expansion
